Description

Enjoy a Smart Pumping Life!

*Upgrade to Efficiency, Upgrade to Portability

The 3rd-gen pump motor offers powerful suction up to -300mmHg to increase milk volume

*Your Pattern, Your Comfort

Personalise patterns via the Momcozy app, adjusting mode and intensity to suit your comfort and preference

*Sealed with Comfort, Brimming with Confidence

Embrace a snug and comfortable fit, courtesy of the DoubleFit™ flange

*Liberate Your Pumping Journey

Streamlined design for mess-free milk expression, offering unmatched convenience, portability, and freedom

*Pump Without Limits

On a single charge, enjoy 4 to 5 pumping sessions, ideal for busy moms pumping on-the-go

⚠️
Safety Warning

Do NOT use this device if you have a pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

App Features Overview

Pump discreetly using the Momcozy app, ensuring privacy and convenience for confident and empowered pumping sessions anywhere.

Settings Adjustment:
Easily switch between different pumping settings to customise your experience for comfort and efficiency.

Milk Volume Tracking:
Record and monitor volume per session to track progress and maintain a detailed log.

Personal Alerts and Notifications:
Set personalised alerts and receive notifications via the app to stay informed about your pumping schedule and important reminders.

Pumping Modes Overview

1. Professional Recommendations
-
Easily Select via Momcozy App

Experience two expert-recommended pumping modes tailored to your needs, promoting a smooth and enjoyable pumping session.

Milk Boost™: Ideal for moms looking to increase milk supply, this mode enhances breastfeeding by boosting production.

Milk Relief™: Provides balanced milk flow with Quick Release, offering gentle relief and effective milk expression for moms with enlarged breasts, without wasting time.

2. Personalized Preferences – Customize Conveniently via Momcozy App

MyFlow™ Mode: Set your own mode by adjusting the regular mode (stimulation, expression, or mixed) and intensity through the Momcozy app, allowing for a personalized pumping experience that optimizes comfort, efficiency, and milk production.

3. Regular Pumping Modes – Select via Momcozy App or Pump

Stimulation Mode: Features a quick, short sucking pattern to initiate milk flow.

Expression Mode: Provides a slow, steady sucking pattern for effective milk extraction.

Mixed Mode: Combines quick stimulation and slow expression patterns to efficiently extract milk.

This comprehensive range of modes and intensities offers flexibility and effectiveness, catering to various breastfeeding stages and individual preferences.

Specifications and Features

Perfect for working and multitasking moms

Effortlessly balance your career and breastfeeding with powerful efficiency.

Specifications

Modes: Personalized preferences + 2 professional modes (Milk Relief™ & Milk Boost™) + 3 regular modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed)
Adjustable Suction Levels: 15 levels for your comfort
Motor: 3rd-Gen motor delivering superior performance
Vacuum Strength: Up to -300mmHg for efficient milk expression
Flange Size: 24mm (with insert options of 17mm / 19mm / 21mm)
Maximum Usage Time: Up to 150 minutes (4 to 5 pumping sessions)
Noise Level: Under 42dB for quiet pumping
Bottle Capacity: 150ml
Auto Shut-Off: After 30 minutes
Charging Time: About 2.5 hours
Pump Dimensions: 127 mm × 109 mm × 77 mm (5.0 in × 4.3 in × 3.0 in)
Pump Weight: 302 g (10.7 oz)

Gentle Support, Smart Control

Milk Boost™
: For mums looking to enhance milk production.

Milk Relief™
: For mums with engorged breasts who want to gently ease discomfort and express milk.

Choose from three intuitive modes for everyday pumping . No app required.

Expression Mode:
Slow and steady suckling pattern for milk expression.

Mixed Mode:
Combines quick stimulation followed by slow expression for efficient milk extraction.

Stimulation Mode:
Quick and short suckling pattern to initiate milk flow.

Milk Volume Tracking:
Record and monitor the amount of milk expressed during each session to keep track of your progress and maintain a detailed log.

Overflow Alert:
Get vibration alerts and app notifications when your bottle is almost full to help prevent spills and keep your pumping mess-free.

Comfort Meets Innovation

Crafted with food-grade soft and firm silicone, the DoubleFit™ Flange offers a smooth, skin-like feel, enhancing comfort while reducing irritation during every pumping session.

Secure and Invisible

Designed with real mums in mind, the drop-shaped form naturally fits your bra, providing a comfy, secure fit that won't bulge or sag.

Tested in over 1,000 trials to ensure a comfortable fit for a wide range of chest shapes, helping you pump confidently and discreetly – even at work.

The DoubleFit™ Flange is made from food-grade silicone, and is FDA- and LFGB-certified for safe milk contact.

The PPSU funnel tunnel can withstand temperatures from 135°C to 179°C and endure multiple boiling cycles without deformation.

The Tritan milk bowl is durable, highly transparent, and resistant to over 100 boiling cycles.

Effortless Extraction

Effortless Extraction

Works in Sync With You

The PowerFlow™ system features an upgraded 3rd-generation motor, delivering -300mmHg suction with 15 finely tuned levels – helping you find the most comfortable and efficient rhythm at every stage.

3rd-Gen Motor

Our latest technology

offers superior performance

-300mmHg Suction

Ensures efficient

milk extraction

Quiet and Discreet

At just 42dB, Mobile Flow™ is the quietest* wearable pump in the -300mmHg suction class. Whether you're in a meeting, on your commute, or at your desk, you can express discreetly without drawing attention.

*Tested for noise levels in -300mmHg suction mode compared to other wearable pumps that reach -300mmHg suction strength. (Internal testing, 2024).

Ready in Minutes, Even If You're Not

When the battery is fully drained, just 12 minutes of charging with a 5V/2A adapter* gives you enough power for one full pumping cycle –perfect for those moments when you're on the go and have forgotten to charge.

*Power adapter is not included in the package.

Store Safe and Clean

The separate Tritan milk bowl allows you to pump and store – with no need to clean anything – allowing you to spend more time on what matters.

FAQs

Is Momcozy M9 hospital-grade breast pump?

Momcozy M9 is a wearable, personal breast pump with
hospital-grade suction power
. It is helpful to know the distinction between a "hospital-grade" pump and "hospital-grade suction."

A "hospital-grade" breast pump is a multi-use, rental pump designed for use in a hospital or clinical settings. They are made in a closed system so the milk won't get into the motor or tubing, so they can be shared with many mothers safely. They are most commonly for mums who need to establish their milk supply or mums with a baby in the NICU.

On the other hand, "hospital-grade suction power" refers to the suction power and cycle rate of the pump. This is used to refer to a pump that can produce sufficient suction to initiate and maintain a milk supply by mimicking a powerful suckling baby.

Brief and to the point, the Momcozy M9 delivers powerful performance in a convenient, hands-free configuration that's perfect for personal, in-your-home or on-the-go applications. Unless you have a medical need for a multi-user pump, a personal pump with hospital-grade suction like the M9 should be ample power for your daily pumping needs.

What is the suction level of the Momcozy M9?

The Momcozy M9 offers a powerful
maximum suction strength of -300mmHg
, which is designed to be highly effective for milk expression. To give you full control and comfort, the pump provides 3 distinct modes:

Stimulation Mode
to gently stimulate let-down.

Expression Mode
for efficient milk output.

Mixed Mode
which alternates between the two for a more natural feel.

You can further fine-tune the suction intensity across a total of 15 adjustable levels within these modes, allowing you to find the perfect setting for your comfort and milk flow.

There is no single "best" pump among the Momcozy M5, M6, and M9;
the best choice depends on your personal needs and pumping style. The
key differences lie in their design, motor power, and advanced
features.

Can I get Momcozy M9 through insurance?

Yes
, you can get a Momcozy M9 breast pump through your insurance by working with one of our Durable Medical Equipment (DME) partners.

A DME partner is a professional firm that helps you get medical devices like breast pumps under your insurance plan. They approach your insurance company directly to provide the verification, authorization, and claims process on your behalf. You will require a prescription from a health care provider, e.g., a doctor or midwife, to begin with.

The most significant reasons for obtaining your pump from a DME partner are:

Cost Savings
: The pump is generally paid for by the insurance at little or no cost to you.

Hassle-Free Process
: Your DME partner takes care of all paperwork and communication with your insurance company.

Expert Guidance
: They will arrange for all appropriate documentation to be submitted to meet insurance requirements.

Which is better, Spectra or Momcozy M9?

Both Spectra and Momcozy are trusted breast pump brands, but they are designed for different user needs, so the best choice depends on your lifestyle.

Spectra is best known for its traditional pumps with a large main unit and tubing that connects them. These pumps are most often used in a stationary setting, focusing on powerful, hospital-grade suction for optimal efficiency.

In comparison, the Momcozy M9 is a wearable, hands-free breast pump. Due to its all-in-one, foldable format, you can wear it in your bra while moving about, multitasking, or pumping anywhere without being tethered with tubes or plugged in. Therefore, if discretion and mobility are your top priorities, a wearable pump like the M9 is your best bet.

What Makes Momcozy M9 a Good, Smart, and Hands-Free Breast Pump?

The Momcozy M9 smart breast pump is designed for today’s busy moms who need a reliable, efficient, and discreet solution. As a hands-free breast pump, the M9 features powerful suction and efficient milk extraction – all in a lightweight, wearable design.

With app-controlled settings, you can easily adjust suction levels, modes, and track milk output right from your phone, with no need to interrupt your routine. The portable and stackable milk collectors make it easy to pump on the go and store milk without the mess.

Whether you're juggling work, travel, or just daily life, the Momcozy M9 gives you the freedom to pump wherever and whenever you need, with comfort, confidence, and total control.

Do Wearable Pumps Decrease Milk Supply?

A wearable pump does not decrease milk supply, as long as it provides strong and effective suction. Suction strength is key to fully emptying the breast, which helps maintain a healthy milk supply.

Wearable pumps like the Momcozy S12 Pro are designed with high suction power to ensure efficient milk removal, so you can pump hands-free without compromising your milk production.

Can I Exclusively Pump with a Hands-Free Pump?

Yes, you can exclusively pump with a hands-free breast pump. In fact, many moms find hands-free pumping to be a convenient and effective way to build and maintain milk supply, especially when nursing isn’t an option.

The key is using a high-performance pump that fully empties the breasts. A smart, wearable option like the Momcozy M9, with powerful suction up to -300 mmHg and a comfortable DoubleFit™ flange, is designed to support exclusive pumping, without compromising comfort or milk output.

For the best results, it’s a good idea to consult with a lactation professional to create a pumping schedule that matches your goals.

What Is a Good Hands-Free Pump?

A good hands-free breast pump should offer strong suction, a comfortable fit, and quiet operation – while giving mums the freedom to pump while multitasking. Look for a pump with adjustable suction levels, a leak-proof design, and discreet wearability for pumping confidently at work, at home, or on the go.

The app-controlled settings let you personalise your pumping experience for maximum comfort and output.
